Nvidia faces a leadership transition following Jensen Huang's reported exit as CEO. With CFO Colette Kress named interim chief, the race for a permanent successor is drawing attention. From Ian Buck and Rene Haas to Indian-origin executives Sanjay Mehrotra, Nikesh Arora and Thomas Kurian, who could lead Nvidia next?
